newsitem.title: JAPAN: France's EDF launches 30 bln yen in samurais-Nikko.
newsitem.headline: France's EDF launches 30 bln yen in samurais-Nikko.

text.p: Electricite de France (EDF) launched a total of 30 billion yen in dual-currency samurai bonds on Thursday, lead-manager Nikko Securities said.
Of the 30 billion yen, 20 billion is a yen/Australian dollar dual samurai issue with a coupon of 5.2 percent.
The remaining 10 billion yen is a yen/U.S. dollar dual bond issue carrying a 4.6 percent coupon.
The breakdown of the terms for the yen/Australian dollar
dual issue is as follows.
AMT 20 bln yen COUPON 5.2 pct MATURITY Nov 18, 1999
TYPE yen/A$ samurai ISS PRICE 100 yen
PAY DATE Nov 22, 1996
SIGN DATE Nov 8, 1996
SUB PERIOD Nov 11 to Nov 21
INTEREST PAYMENT May 18 and Nov 18
LAST RATING Aaa(Moody's), AAA(S&P)
LEAD MANAGER Nikko Securities
LEAD TRUSTEE Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd
The coupon will be paid in yen, while redemption will be in Australian dollars.
Holders of the samurai bonds will receive A$5,524.86 for each 500,000-yen bond held at maturity.
The breakdown of the terms for the yen/U.S. dollar dual issue is as follows. AMT 10 bln yen COUPON 4.6 pct MATURITY Nov 18, 1999
TYPE yen/US$ samurai ISS PRICE 100 yen PAY DATE Nov 22, 1996
SIGN DATE Nov 8, 1996
SUB PERIOD Nov 11 to Nov 21
INTEREST PAYMENT May 18 and Nov 18 LAST RATING Aaa(Moody's), AAA(S&P)
LEAD MANAGER Nikko Securities
LEAD TRUSTEE Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd
The coupon will be paid in yen, while redemption will be in U.S. dollars.
Holders of the samurai bonds will receive US$4,366.81 for each 500,000 yen bond held at maturity.
